items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: Her father was Luis Russell, who worked with Louis Armstrong’s band.

ctx.x: Let me put this on here, if I can make it work.

Wonderful people in this band. David Glasser played with Basie’s band for a while, alto player, just wonderful. Larry Ham is not as well known as everybody else but he’s an incredible sensitive piano player. He’s got a lot of technique. He’s a wonderful person to work with. The vocalist is absolutely the top of the line. Her father was Luis Russell, who worked with Louis Armstrong’s band.
